description: Source code for E2SM-CCC ASN.1 packer, including functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, handling control requests, and packing RAN function descriptions.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_asn1_packer
classes.description: Class responsible for packing and handling E2SM-CCC ASN.1 messages, including control service management and RAN function description.

methods.name: json_to_octstring
methods.description: Converts JSON object to ASN.1 octet string.

methods.name: octstring_to_json
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 octet string back to JSON object.

methods.name: e2sm_ccc_asn1_packer
methods.description: Constructor for the ASN.1 packer class.

methods.name: add_e2sm_control_service
methods.description: Adds a control service to the packer.

methods.name: handle_packed_event_trigger_definition
methods.description: Handles packed event trigger definitions (not supported).

methods.name: handle_packed_e2sm_action_definition
methods.description: Handles packed E2SM action definitions (not supported).

methods.name: handle_packed_ric_control_request
methods.description: Processes packed RIC control request into internal structure.

methods.name: pack_ric_control_response
methods.description: Serializes RIC control response into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: pack_ran_function_description
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 encoded RAN function description.
